title: Session revocations at scale
summary: Keeps deploys from stampeding MySQL for revocations by seeding gateway caches from sorted binary chunks in S3.

title: The foundations of Canva's continuous data platform with Snowpipe Streaming
summary: Swaps Firehose, whose per-record billing floor inflated costs, for Snowpipe Streaming with one client per KCL shard.

title: Real-time mouse pointers
summary: Moves pointer traffic from single-node Redis PubSub, too small for faster updates, to a WebRTC data channel mesh.

title: How Canva collects 25 billion events per day
summary: Replaces SQS and SNS, which dominated the bill, with Kinesis streams that overflow to SQS on throttling or stalls.

title: Behind the draw - How Canva's drawing tool works
summary: Shrinks strokes that hit the design size limit with coordinate rounding, Ramer-Douglas-Peucker and polygon union.

title: From Zero to 50 Million Uploads per Day: Scaling Media at Canva
summary: Escapes MySQL's schema-change and replication limits by moving media live to DynamoDB through ID-only SQS messages.

title: Search Pipeline: Part II
summary: Lets Canva's search systems share components via ordered pipeline steps that read but never mutate earlier output.

title: Machine learning hyperparameter optimization with Argo
summary: Ends sequential tuning on vertically scaled trainers with Optuna map-reduce rounds of parallel trainers on Argo.

title: Enabling real-time collaboration with RSocket
summary: Avoids a WebSocket per service with a gateway multiplexing RSocket channels whose backpressure isolates failures.
